verdict.rationale: Persona's Hosted Flow is explicitly documented as the fastest, no-code way to get a verification link/page in front of a user without any frontend engineering work (docs-8, docs-11), which fits an ops lead's need to send a one-off verification link. However, there is no evidence of a QR code generation feature or of a self-serve ops-facing dashboard workflow for creating/sending these links without any engineering setup (e.g., initial template/workflow configuration still appears developer-oriented). Missing for 10: QR code support, explicit ops-lead self-service link creation UI, and evidence of zero engineering involvement in initial setup.
